scope: Reviewed official route-planning and incident-information entry points, not an address-level route assignment or a complete statewide route inventory.

calalerts.title: Cal OES county alert directory
calalerts.description: Choose your county to find its alert program before an emergency. This is a signup directory, not a current evacuation order or route map.
calalerts.review: Official directory read; enrollment not attempted. County registration links may require an account.

caltrans.title: Caltrans current highway conditions
caltrans.description: Check a state highway number for reported restrictions and closures, or call 1-800-427-7623. Road information does not assign an evacuation route or cover every local street.
caltrans.review: Official highway lookup and recorded-information number read. No current road state is embedded.

yolo.title: Yolo County evacuation zones and instructions
yolo.kind: Local zone lookup and evacuation guidance
yolo.description: Find your address in the county-linked Genasys map, note your zone and read the zone information. Follow the route in official incident instructions; not every incident uses the map.
yolo.review: Official publisher indexed text read; direct retrieval returned 403. West Sacramento's official Evacuation Routes page corroborates zone-specific planning routes. No active route verified.

los-angeles.title: Los Angeles County emergency information
los-angeles.kind: Official incident updates and zone-status link
los-angeles.description: Read incident instructions and follow the county's Genasys link to check your address. Zone status is not a street-by-street evacuation route.
los-angeles.review: Official page and June 9, 2026 county notice identify Genasys for status. The emergency page includes inactive template text; no displayed status or incident is copied.

san-diego.title: San Diego County emergency map
san-diego.description: Open Emergency Map for agency-published evacuation routes, notification areas and traffic controls when supplied for an incident. Boundaries can lag or change; follow official instructions.
san-diego.review: Official Maps page explicitly lists evacuation routes. County service metadata warns of approximate boundaries and reporting delays. No current route geometry or active order is saved.

san-mateo.title: San Mateo County evacuation-zone status
san-mateo.description: Use the county's Genasys link to look up your address and zone. Supplement it with official alerts; a zone boundary does not specify which road to use.
san-mateo.review: Primary county guidance read. County distinguishes mapping information from its alert-and-warning system.

humboldt.title: Humboldt County evacuation mapping
humboldt.description: Find your zone through the county-linked map and check Humboldt Alert instructions. Use the route officials give; the saved book contains no active zone status.
humboldt.review: Official publisher guidance read; current status and available routes are not imported.

santa-cruz-county.title: Santa Cruz County evacuation information
santa-cruz-county.kind: County evacuation planning and incident links
santa-cruz-county.description: Check county evacuation information and the official zone map for your address. Do not use a neighboring city's route sheet for your location.
santa-cruz-county.review: Official county evacuation page read. City-specific route sheets are selected separately.

santa-cruz-city.title: City of Santa Cruz evacuation route sheets
santa-cruz-city.kind: Advance route planning - City of Santa Cruz only
santa-cruz-city.description: Look up your address, then choose its SCZ-001 to SCZ-031 PDF under Evacuation Zone Maps. The city says these show ways out for planning; responders choose routes during an emergency.
santa-cruz-city.review: Official page and 31 zone-sheet links read; linked SCZ-001 PDF retrieval returned 403. No map geometry, address-to-zone match or current safe route was verified.

tsunami-maps.title: California Geological Survey tsunami maps
tsunami-maps.kind: Hazard planning maps, not incident routes
tsunami-maps.description: Select the coastal county and check the map date. Use local posted evacuation routes and signs; hazard shading alone does not specify a safe street or destination.
tsunami-maps.review: Official statewide county index read. County map dates differ; no current warning or safe area is inferred.

tsunami-guidance.title: NWS: Before a tsunami
tsunami-guidance.review: Official evacuation planning guidance read: local assembly areas or inland/high ground outside the zone; plan on foot when possible because of road damage, closures and traffic.

flood-guidance.title: NWS: During a flood
flood-guidance.review: Official evacuation, flooded-road and barricade guidance read.

general-guidance.title: CAL FIRE: Get Ready to Go
general-guidance.review: Official household preparation and early evacuation guidance read; not an active route assignment.
